title: Campaign Authorization (signed pre-authorized send envelope)
description: A single operator-signed authorization for a CLASS of outbound sends. The operator signs this ONCE per campaign. Every individual send must be provably inside the envelope this document defines: audience, copy, variable allowlist, cadence, opt-out, and kill switch. render_message.py is the code that enforces this contract at render time.

campaign_id.description: Stable short identifier for this campaign, e.g. ARG-C1. Referenced by the kill switch file and by render_message.py.

valid_time_utc.description: When this authorization is valid FOR (the campaign's operative window start), in UTC, RFC3339, Z-suffixed.

transaction_time_utc.description: When this authorization record was WRITTEN, in UTC, RFC3339, Z-suffixed. Bitemporal pair with valid_time_utc.

operator_signature.description: Null until the operator signs. A code lane must never set this to a non-null value. Absence of a non-null signature means this authorization has no world-effect standing.

audience_definition.description: Describes the CLASS of recipient this authorization covers, not an enumerated list. The actual prospect rows live in a separate targets file and must each satisfy inclusion_rule and fail every exclusion_rule.

max_prospects_total.description: Ceiling on how many distinct prospects this authorization ever covers, across the whole sequence.

max_sends_per_day.description: Ceiling on outbound sends per calendar day under this authorization, across all sequence steps combined.

copy_template_sha256.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the primary (step 1 / initial) template file. render_message.py refuses to render any template file whose sha256 does not equal this value.

variable_allowlist.description: The complete, exhaustive set of {{var}} placeholder names any template under this authorization may use. Any template variable outside this list is a refusal, not a warning.

sequence.description: Ordered cadence steps. wait_days is measured from step 1 (day 0). Each step names the sha256 of the exact template file authorized for that step.

opt_out_language.description: Exact opt-out sentence(s) that must appear VERBATIM in every rendered message body. render_message.py refuses (exit 4) any render whose body does not contain this string exactly.

reply_policy.description: How inbound replies are handled. This authorization does not itself implement reply handling; it only declares which policy governs it.

kill_switch_path.description: Filesystem path to this campaign's KILL_SWITCH.json. render_message.py refuses (exit 7) whenever the file at this path does not read state == ARMED for this campaign_id.

review_cadence_hours.description: Maximum hours between operator/monitor reviews of this campaign's live state while it is ARMED.

physical_postal_address.description: CAN-SPAM requires a valid physical postal address in every commercial email. If this value starts with the literal marker UNVERIFIED, no send under this authorization is CAN-SPAM-compliant and render_message.py's caller must treat that as a hard blocker independent of any envelope check.

effect_ceiling.description: Names the world-effect class this authorization can ever produce: an external send, and only within this envelope. Fixed value so the field itself cannot be used to smuggle a higher effect tier.
